arguments.code:
# Execute rating updates/creates for all songs in liked playlists

access_token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2FzX21vb3JlQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsImV4cCI6MTY4NDQxMjA5OH0.Ry-dT0WNVUiSCQYSD3KUYzl-EGoNtS5NB0ssm2lBGNQ'
user_email='as_moore@gmail.com'

# If need_actions isn't present (fresh env), recompute quickly
try:
    need_actions
except NameError:
    # recompute
    liked_playlists=[]
    i=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp=apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=access_token,page_index=i,page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        liked_playlists.extend(resp)
        i+=1

    song_ids=set()
    for p in liked_playlists:
        for sid in p.get('song_ids',[]):
            song_ids.add(sid)

    song_ids=sorted(song_ids)
    need_actions=[]
    for sid in song_ids:
        page_index=0
        page_limit=20
        all_reviews=[]
        while True:
            resp=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid, user_email=user_email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
            if not resp:
                break
            all_reviews.extend(resp)
            page_index+=1
        if len(all_reviews)==0:
            need_actions.append({'song_id':sid,'action':'create','review_ids':[]})
        else:
            low=[r['song_review_id'] for r in all_reviews if r.get('rating',5) < 5]
            if low:
                need_actions.append({'song_id':sid,'action':'update','review_ids':low})
            else:
                # already 5, no action
                pass

# Now execute actions
results=[]
idx=0
for item in need_actions:
    idx+=1
    sid=item['song_id']
    if item['action']=='create':
        resp=apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=sid, rating=5, access_token=access_token)
        results.append({'song_id':sid,'action':'create','resp':resp})
        print('CREATE',idx,'song_id',sid,'->',resp)
    elif item['action']=='update':
        # update all low review ids
        for rid in item['review_ids']:
            resp=apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=rid, access_token=access_token, rating=5)
            results.append({'song_id':sid,'action':'update','review_id':rid,'resp':resp})
            print('UPDATE',idx,'song_id',sid,'review_id',rid,'->',resp)
    else:
        print('UNKNOWN action',item)

print('Total action calls:',len(results))

# Verification: fetch reviews for each song_id and check at least one rating==5
from collections import defaultdict
song_to_ratings=defaultdict(list)
for item in need_actions:
    sid=item['song_id']
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    all_reviews=[]
    while True:
        resp=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid, user_email=user_email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        all_reviews.extend(resp)
        page_index+=1
    ratings=[r.get('rating') for r in all_reviews]
    song_to_ratings[sid]=ratings

# summarize
all_songs=set([i['song_id'] for i in need_actions])
verified=0
not5=[]
for sid in sorted(all_songs):
    ratings=song_to_ratings.get(sid,[])
    if not ratings:
        not5.append((sid,ratings))
    else:
        # consider max rating; if any rating==5 treat as ok
        if any(float(x)==5.0 for x in ratings):
            verified+=1
        else:
            not5.append((sid,ratings))
print('Songs targeted:',len(all_songs))
print('Verified with rating==5:',verified)
print('Not having any 5-star rating:',not5)
